headline: Capital Trust shifts its registered office location
hook: New corporate coordinates for Capital Trust
summary: Capital Trust Limited has officially informed the stock exchanges regarding a change in its registered office address. The procedural filing updates the company's official correspondence location. No financial impact or operational disruption has been reported alongside the address change. Indian retail investors holding the stock face no immediate fundamental changes from this administrative update.
why_it_matters: Purely administrative update with zero direct impact on your investment value.
